verdict.rationale: Pylon's Support Agent is grounded in a curated knowledge base, runbooks, and rubrics (pylon-docs-13, 20, 45, 73, 74) and can be tested via simulation before deployment (pylon-docs-17), which are the building blocks for constraining agent behavior, but there is no explicit documentation of a hallucination-prevention or 'safe decline on unknown' mechanism for off-knowledge questions. missing for 10: explicit fallback/decline behavior spec, guardrail policy against inventing prices/promises, and any hands-on evidence the agent actually declines rather than guesses.
